clauses.quote: The Association shall inform the Human Resources Office of the names of unit members who have donated sick leave days and how many days they have donated.
The Association shall provide the District, upon written request, information and documentation regarding eligibility for catastrophic leave and related matters.
A unit member may file a grievance alleging a violation of sections 10.6.2, 10.6.3, and 10.6.4 only.
Catastrophic Leave shall be reopened at the request of either party.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit actor is district management.

clauses.quote: Reassignments shall be made at the discretion of the site administration, subject to the provisions of 11.4 and 11.5 below.
clauses.notes: Grants discretionary authority to management over reassignment processes.
